name: Ichimonji Kaoru
source: The boss of the delinquents. He will challenge you if the player beats all of his subordinates. If, however, you are trying to win with Akane then you will have to face him as he is revealed to be her brother.
translation: The boss of the delinquents. He will challenge you if the player beats all of his subordinates. If, however, you are trying to win with Akane then you will have to face him as he is revealed to be her brother.
